0.original: A certain culinary device is in need of repairs, and the desperate look in Managingway's eyes can only portend one thing.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

1.original: Speak with the Loporrit mechanic in the Carrotorium.

2.original: Deliver the requested item to the Loporrit mechanic.

24.original: Speak with the Loporrit mechanic in the Carrotorium.

48.original: The cooking station has been a smashing success since its grand opening, and I couldn't be more pleased! ...Well, perhaps I <hex:021A020203>could<hex:021A020103> be more pleased should the others stop clambering over one another just to get a taste of Cookingway's culinary twists on the traditional carrot.

49.original: Unfortunately, his indispensable carrot chiller has broken down amidst the overwhelming demand, and many of us─myself included─wish for it to be repaired posthaste. The drop in productivity the workshop suffers in its absence is not to be borne.

50.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, have you heard? Oh, it's just awful─the carrot chiller you helped to repair has broken down again!

51.original: As you're aware, the cooking station's frozen beverages are the talk of the hold, and nary a soul can keep their paws off of them. Hence, the carrot chiller is─or rather <hex:021A020203>was<hex:021A020103> in perpetual use. Inventingway himself is seeing if he can refine the design to prevent this from happening again.

52.original: One of our Ways in charge of overseeing repairs has already gone to inspect it, but surely the process would go faster if you were there to assist them. I urge you to meet with them in the Carrotorium as soon as you are able.

53.original: <beep> Hello! Do you have any instructions? This supporter <hex:021A020203>loves<hex:021A020103> instructions!

54.original: What's that? You'll help me with the repairs? Oh, how very kind of you! Well then, give me just a moment to figure out how to distribute the remaining tasks.

55.original: Let's see here... Well, the cooling mechanism has seen better days. With your expertise, I wager you could make a suitable replacement in no time. Think you can put one together with these parts?

56.original: Let's see here... Well, the chiller's insulative fabric has deteriorated a good deal, but I have all the necessary materials to stitch a few more yalms together. Think you could manage that?

57.original: Let's see here... Well, the coolant for the chiller seems to have degraded. With your expertise, I wager you could make a much more effective one in no time. Think you can manage that with these ingredients?

58.original: <beep> You require materials? But you have plenty already! Just think of how those poor materials would feel if they went perpetually unused. Go on, think about it.

59.original: <beep> You require materials? But you have plenty already! Just think of how those poor materials would feel if they went perpetually unused. Go on, think about it.

60.original: <beep> You require materials? But you have plenty already! Just think of how those poor materials would feel if they went perpetually unused. Go on, think about it.

61.original: <beep> Oh, do you require additional materials? Acknowledged, acknowledged! Just give this supporter a moment to fire up its transfer protocols!

62.original: <beep> Oh, do you require additional materials? Acknowledged, acknowledged! Just give this supporter a moment to fire up its transfer protocols!

63.original: <beep> Oh, do you require additional materials? Acknowledged, acknowledged! Just give this supporter a moment to fire up its transfer protocols!

64.original: If you run out of materials, the supporter beside me will be able to resupply you with whatever you need.

66.original: M-My word, this is absolutely remarkable! Fine work, my friend, fine work!

67.original: I will set about getting the chiller up and running again with what you've made. Pray return to Managingway and let them know it will soon be in working order!

68.original: Fret not, I shall see to the carrot chiller's repairs. You need but return to Managingway and let them know it shall soon be in working order!

69.original: Oh, that's wonderful news, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. It sounds like the machine will be ready much sooner than we'd anticipated. I cannot thank you enough.

70.original: Why does the carrot chiller see such fierce demand, you ask? Well, allow me to answer your question with another: how would <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> react to a delicious beverage comprised of pulverized chilled carrots?

71.original: I thought so. The staff at the cooking station can even combine your favorite carrots and blend them into an original drink to keep you alert and refreshed─or whatever else you fancy, I suppose. Hmmm, perhaps I should put in my next order sooner rather than later...

72.original: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
